patch_description: The current program is monolithic and lacks modularity, making it hard to extend or debug. By breaking down the contact planning logic into smaller functions, we can make the code more maintainable and easier to understand. Each function will handle a specific part of the planning process, such as initializing the plan, appending modes, and performing walking steps. This separation of concerns will also make it easier to evolve the program by modifying individual functions without affecting the entire codebase.
